name: Pesarattu
steps: Soak green gram for 4–6 hours.
Grind with chilli, ginger, cumin and water to make a batter.
Spread on a hot pan and cook both sides until crisp.

name: Gutti Vankaya Curry
steps: Slit the brinjals without cutting through.
Roast and grind peanuts, sesame and coconut with spices.
Stuff brinjals, sauté with onion, add water and simmer until tender.

name: Gongura Pachadi
steps: Wash and dry gongura leaves.
Sauté leaves and chillies until leaves soften; cool and grind.
Temper mustard seeds and garlic in oil and mix in.

name: Andhra Chicken Curry
steps: Sauté onions until golden and add ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato and spices; cook until soft.
Add chicken and water, cover and simmer until fully cooked.

name: Chepala Pulusu
steps: Soak tamarind and extract the pulp.
Cook onion, tomato and spices in oil.
Add tamarind water and fish; simmer gently until fish is cooked.

name: Royyala Iguru
steps: Clean prawns and set aside.
Sauté onion and ginger-garlic paste; add tomato and spices.
Add prawns and cook until firm and the gravy thickens.

name: Gongura Mutton
steps: Cook mutton with turmeric and water until tender.
Sauté onion, ginger-garlic paste and spices.
Add gongura leaves and cooked mutton; simmer until flavours combine.

name: Tomato Pappu
steps: Pressure-cook dal, tomatoes, chillies and turmeric until soft.
Mash the dal and adjust consistency with water.
Temper mustard seeds and garlic in oil and stir into the dal.

name: Mamidikaya Pappu
steps: Cook dal with raw mango, chillies and turmeric until soft.
Mash and season with salt.
Add a mustard-seed and curry-leaf tempering.

name: Bendakaya Pulusu
steps: Soak tamarind and prepare its extract.
Sauté sliced okra and onion until lightly cooked.
Add tamarind, spices and a little jaggery; simmer until thick.

name: Andhra Chicken Fry
steps: Marinate chicken with spices and lemon.
Cook covered with a little water until tender.
Fry with curry leaves until browned and cooked through.

name: Punugulu
steps: Mix batter with chopped onion, chilli, cumin and curry leaves.
Heat oil in a deep pan.
Drop small portions into hot oil and fry until golden; drain well.

name: Mirchi Bajji
steps: Slit and deseed chillies if desired.
Mix flours, spices and water into a thick batter.
Dip chillies and fry until crisp and golden.

name: Bobbatlu
steps: Cook chana dal until soft and drain well.
Mash with jaggery and cardamom to make the filling.
Wrap filling in soft dough, flatten gently and cook on a greased pan.

name: Pootharekulu
steps: Prepare or obtain very thin rice starch sheets.
Brush each sheet lightly with ghee.
Layer with sugar, cardamom and nuts, then fold carefully.

name: Avakaya Pachadi
steps: Wash mangoes and dry completely before cutting.
Mix mango pieces with salt, mustard, chilli and fenugreek powders.
Add sesame oil, mix well and store in a clean dry jar.

name: Andhra Sambar
steps: Cook dal until soft and extract tamarind pulp.
Boil vegetables with tamarind and sambar powder.
Add dal and simmer; finish with mustard-seed and curry-leaf tempering.

name: Pulihora
steps: Prepare thick tamarind sauce with turmeric and salt.
Temper mustard seeds, chillies, peanuts and curry leaves.
Mix sauce into cooled rice and let flavours settle.

name: Dibba Rotti
steps: Soak and grind urad dal into a thick batter.
Mix with soaked rice rava, ginger, chilli, cumin and salt.
Cook covered in a thick pan on low heat until both sides are golden.

name: Poornam Boorelu
steps: Cook chana dal and mash with jaggery and cardamom.
Make a smooth coating batter from soaked rice and urad dal.
Shape filling into balls, coat with batter and fry until golden.

name: Idli
steps: Soak rice and urad dal separately, then grind.
Ferment the batter overnight and add salt.
Pour into idli moulds and steam until fluffy.

name: Masala Dosa
steps: Cook potatoes and mash roughly.
Prepare potato masala with onion, mustard seeds and curry leaves.
Spread dosa batter thinly on a hot pan, cook crisp and fill with masala.

name: Plain Dosa
steps: Stir fermented batter to an even consistency.
Spread a ladle of batter thinly on a hot pan.
Drizzle a little oil and cook until crisp; flip if desired.

name: Medu Vada
steps: Soak urad dal and grind with minimal water.
Mix in pepper, ginger, chilli and curry leaves.
Shape rings carefully and fry until golden and cooked through.

name: Ven Pongal
steps: Dry-roast moong dal briefly.
Cook rice and dal together with water until soft.
Season with pepper, cumin, ginger, cashews and ghee.

name: Lemon Rice
steps: Cool cooked rice so grains remain separate.
Temper mustard seeds, peanuts, chillies and turmeric.
Turn off heat, add lemon juice and mix with rice.

name: Curd Rice
steps: Mash cooled rice lightly and mix with yogurt and a little milk.
Prepare a tempering with mustard seeds, ginger and curry leaves.
Mix the tempering into the rice and serve cool.

name: Bisi Bele Bath
steps: Cook rice and dal until soft.
Cook vegetables with tamarind and spice powder.
Combine everything, simmer to a thick consistency and garnish with peanuts.

name: Kerala Appam
steps: Soak and grind rice with cooked rice and coconut milk.
Add yeast, sugar and salt; ferment until bubbly.
Pour into an appam pan, swirl and cook covered until the centre is soft.

name: Vegetable Upma
steps: Dry-roast rava until fragrant.
Sauté mustard seeds, curry leaves, onion and vegetables.
Add hot water and salt, then stir in rava gradually until fluffy.

name: Chole Bhature
steps: Soak and cook chickpeas until tender.
Prepare onion-tomato gravy with chole masala and add chickpeas.
Make bhature dough, rest it, roll and fry until puffed.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
steps: Cook tomatoes, onion and cashews until soft; blend smoothly.
Simmer the sauce with butter and spices.
Add paneer and a little cream; simmer gently.

name: Dal Makhani
steps: Soak lentils and beans overnight, then cook until soft.
Simmer with tomato, ginger and spices.
Cook slowly, stirring occasionally; finish with butter and cream.

name: Aloo Paratha
steps: Make a soft dough from wheat flour and water.
Mash cooked potatoes with spices and coriander.
Fill dough balls, roll gently and cook on a hot pan with ghee.

name: Palak Paneer
steps: Blanch spinach briefly and blend to a puree.
Cook onion, tomato, ginger, garlic and spices.
Add spinach puree and paneer; simmer gently.

name: Rajma Chawal
steps: Soak kidney beans overnight and cook until tender.
Make an onion-tomato masala with cumin and spices.
Add beans and cooking liquid; simmer and serve with rice.

name: Kadai Paneer
steps: Coarsely crush roasted coriander seeds and chilli.
Sauté onion and capsicum; add tomatoes and spices.
Add paneer and toss until coated and heated through.

name: Butter Naan
steps: Mix flour with yogurt, yeast, sugar, salt and water to form dough.
Rest until risen, then divide and roll.
Cook on a hot pan or tandoor-style surface and brush with butter.

name: Vegetable Pulao
steps: Rinse and soak rice briefly.
Sauté whole spices, onion, ginger-garlic paste and vegetables.
Add rice and measured water; cover and cook until fluffy.

name: Malai Kofta
steps: Mash paneer and cooked potatoes, shape into balls and fry.
Blend cooked tomatoes and cashews into a smooth gravy.
Simmer gravy with spices and cream; add kofta just before serving.

name: Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt, spices and herbs.
Parboil rice separately until partly cooked.
Layer chicken and rice, seal and cook on low heat until chicken and rice are done.

name: Chicken 65
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt, spices and flours.
Fry in batches until cooked through and crisp.
Toss with curry leaves and green chillies sautéed in a little oil.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt and spices, then grill or pan-cook.
Prepare tomato gravy with ginger, garlic and spices.
Add cooked chicken and cream; simmer until flavours combine.

name: Mutton Curry
steps: Sauté onion and ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomatoes, spices and mutton; cook until coated.
Add water and simmer or pressure-cook until mutton is tender.

name: Egg Curry
steps: Boil eggs, peel and make small slits.
Prepare onion-tomato gravy with spices.
Add eggs and simmer for several minutes.

name: Fish Fry
steps: Coat fish with lemon, ginger-garlic paste and spices.
Rest briefly to marinate.
Shallow-fry until crisp outside and cooked through inside.

name: Prawn Curry
steps: Sauté onion and tomato with spices.
Add coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add prawns and cook just until opaque and firm.

name: Butter Chicken
steps: Cook marinated chicken by grilling or pan-searing.
Blend cooked tomatoes with spices into a smooth sauce.
Simmer chicken in sauce and finish with butter and cream.

name: Chicken Korma
steps: Brown onions and blend with cashews.
Sauté whole spices and ginger-garlic paste, then add chicken.
Stir in yogurt and onion-cashew paste; simmer until chicken is cooked.

name: Egg Biryani
steps: Boil and peel eggs; lightly season them.
Cook onion, tomato, herbs and spices; add eggs.
Layer with partly cooked rice and steam until fully cooked.

name: Samosa
steps: Make a firm dough and rest it.
Prepare a spiced potato and pea filling.
Shape pastry cones, fill, seal and fry over medium-low heat until crisp.

name: Pakoda
steps: Mix sliced onion and spices with gram flour and a little water.
Heat oil in a deep pan.
Drop small portions and fry until golden and cooked through.

name: Onion Bajji
steps: Slice onions into rings.
Make a thick spiced batter with the flours and water.
Coat onion rings and fry until crisp and golden.

name: Aloo Tikki
steps: Mash boiled potatoes with spices and peas.
Shape into flat patties and coat lightly with crumbs.
Shallow-fry until both sides are crisp and golden.

name: Chakodi
steps: Mix rice flour with spices, sesame, butter and hot water.
Shape dough into small rings.
Fry over medium heat until crisp; cool before storing.

name: Murukku
steps: Mix flours, spices, butter and water into a soft dough.
Press dough into spirals using a murukku press.
Fry until crisp and lightly golden.

name: Mysore Bonda
steps: Mix flour, yogurt, chopped chilli, ginger and cumin.
Rest batter briefly and fold in a little baking soda.
Drop spoonfuls into hot oil and fry until golden.

name: Gulab Jamun
steps: Make a smooth soft dough with milk powder, flour and milk.
Shape into small smooth balls and fry on low heat until evenly brown.
Simmer in warm cardamom sugar syrup until softened.

name: Rasgulla
steps: Curdle hot milk with lemon juice and strain the chenna.
Knead until smooth and shape into small balls.
Boil sugar syrup and cook the balls until spongy and expanded.

name: Kaju Katli
steps: Grind cashews into a fine powder without making paste.
Cook sugar and water to a light syrup.
Mix in cashew powder, cook to a dough, roll thin and cut into diamonds.

name: Mysore Pak
steps: Roast gram flour lightly and remove lumps.
Cook sugar and water to a syrup.
Gradually add flour and warm ghee while stirring until porous; set and cut.

name: Laddu
steps: Make a smooth gram-flour batter and fry tiny boondi drops.
Prepare sugar syrup and mix with boondi and cardamom.
Add fried cashews and raisins, cool slightly and shape into laddus.

name: Jalebi
steps: Make a pourable batter and let it ferment briefly.
Prepare a one-string-style sugar syrup with saffron if desired.
Pipe spirals into hot oil, fry crisp and dip in warm syrup.

name: Payasam
steps: Roast vermicelli in a little ghee.
Add milk and simmer until vermicelli is soft.
Sweeten and garnish with cardamom, cashews and raisins.

name: Rava Kesari
steps: Roast rava in ghee until fragrant.
Carefully add hot water and stir until the rava cooks.
Add sugar, cardamom and fried cashews; stir until glossy.

name: Upma
steps: Dry-roast rava.
Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves, ginger, chilli and onion.
Add hot water and salt, then stir in rava and cook until fluffy.

name: Poha
steps: Rinse poha briefly and drain.
Sauté peanuts, onion, potato and turmeric until cooked.
Fold in poha, warm through and finish with lemon juice.

name: Paratha
steps: Knead flour, water and salt into a soft dough.
Rest, divide and roll into flat rounds.
Cook on a hot pan, brushing with ghee until golden spots appear.

name: Palak Dal
steps: Cook dal with turmeric until soft.
Sauté garlic and tomato, then add chopped spinach until wilted.
Mix with dal and simmer; finish with cumin tempering.

name: Mango Rice
steps: Grate raw mango.
Temper mustard seeds, peanuts, chillies and turmeric.
Add grated mango and salt, then mix with cooled rice.

name: Coconut Chutney
steps: Blend coconut, roasted gram, chilli, ginger and water.
Adjust salt and consistency.
Add mustard-seed and curry-leaf tempering.

name: Peanut Chutney
steps: Roast peanuts and chillies, then cool.
Grind with garlic, tamarind, salt and water.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves and mix in.

name: Tomato Chutney
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, chillies and chopped tomatoes until soft.
Cool and grind to the desired texture.
Temper mustard seeds and pour over the chutney.

name: Vegetable Kurma
steps: Cook mixed vegetables until nearly tender.
Blend coconut and cashews with a little water.
Sauté onion and spices, add paste and vegetables, then simmer.

name: Sambar Rice
steps: Cook rice and dal until soft.
Cook vegetables with tamarind and sambar powder.
Combine with rice and dal, adjust water and simmer.

name: Vegetable Biryani
steps: Marinate vegetables with yogurt and spices.
Parboil rice separately.
Layer vegetables and rice with herbs and fried onions; cook covered until done.

name: Mushroom Curry
steps: Clean and slice mushrooms.
Cook onion, ginger-garlic paste, tomato and spices.
Add mushrooms and simmer until tender and gravy thickens.

name: Bhindi Masala
steps: Wash and dry okra completely, then slice.
Sauté okra until less sticky and set aside.
Cook onion, tomato and spices; return okra and cook until tender.

name: Aloo Gobi
steps: Cut potato and cauliflower into even pieces.
Sauté cumin, onion and spices; add vegetables.
Cover and cook on low heat, stirring until tender.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Use cooled cooked rice for separate grains.
Stir-fry chopped vegetables on high heat until just tender.
Add rice and a little soy sauce; toss well and garnish with spring onion.

name: Gobi Manchurian
steps: Coat cauliflower florets in a spiced flour batter.
Fry or bake until crisp and cooked.
Toss with sautéed garlic, soy sauce and spring onion.

name: Paneer Tikka
steps: Mix yogurt, spices and lemon to make a marinade.
Coat paneer and vegetables and rest briefly.
Skewer and grill or pan-cook, turning until lightly charred.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Cook small chicken pieces fully in a hot pan.
Stir-fry vegetables and scramble egg if using.
Add rice, chicken and soy sauce; toss until steaming hot.

name: Chicken Manchurian
steps: Coat chicken pieces with seasoning and cornflour.
Cook chicken thoroughly by frying or pan-cooking.
Make a garlic-ginger soy sauce and toss chicken in it.

name: Keema Curry
steps: Sauté onion and ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato, spices and minced meat; break up lumps.
Add a little water and simmer until fully cooked; add peas if desired.

name: Fish Curry
steps: Prepare tamarind water and season the fish.
Cook onion, tomato and spices into a gravy.
Add tamarind water and fish; simmer gently until cooked.

name: Chicken Soup
steps: Simmer chicken with ginger, onion and water until cooked.
Add chopped carrot and cook until tender.
Season with pepper and salt; shred chicken if desired.

name: Tomato Soup
steps: Cook tomatoes, onion and garlic with water until soft.
Blend and strain if desired.
Reheat with butter, pepper and salt.

name: Vegetable Soup
steps: Chop vegetables into small pieces.
Simmer in water or vegetable stock until tender.
Season with pepper and salt and serve warm.

name: Ragi Sangati
steps: Cook rice with water until soft.
Mix ragi flour with a little water to prevent lumps.
Stir into the rice and cook until thick; shape while warm.

name: Jonna Roti
steps: Mix jowar flour with hot water and salt to form a soft dough.
Pat dough into flat rotis using wet hands.
Cook on a hot pan until both sides are done.

name: Ragi Dosa
steps: Mix flours with yogurt, water, cumin and salt into a thin batter.
Rest briefly.
Pour thinly on a hot greased pan and cook until crisp.

name: Adai
steps: Soak rice and dals, then grind coarsely with chillies and cumin.
Mix in curry leaves and salt.
Spread thick pancakes on a hot pan and cook both sides.

name: Kanchipuram Idli
steps: Season idli batter with crushed pepper, cumin, ginger and curry leaves.
Grease moulds and pour in batter.
Steam until set and cooked through.

name: Dhokla
steps: Mix gram flour, yogurt, water and seasoning into a smooth batter.
Fold in fruit salt just before steaming.
Steam until set and add mustard-seed tempering.

name: Thepla
steps: Mix flour with chopped fenugreek leaves, yogurt and spices.
Knead and rest briefly, then roll thin.
Cook on a hot pan with a little oil until done.

name: Pav Bhaji
steps: Boil vegetables and mash them.
Cook tomatoes and spices with butter; mix in mashed vegetables.
Simmer until thick and serve with toasted buttered rolls.

name: Vada Pav
steps: Make spiced mashed-potato balls.
Dip in gram-flour batter and fry until golden.
Place in pav buns with chutney and serve.

name: Misal Pav
steps: Cook sprouted beans until tender.
Prepare spicy onion-tomato gravy and add beans.
Serve topped with farsan and chopped onion alongside pav.

name: Litti Chokha
steps: Make dough and prepare a sattu filling with spices and mustard oil.
Fill dough balls and bake or roast until cooked.
Mash roasted eggplant, potatoes and tomatoes with seasoning for chokha.

name: Dal Baati Churma
steps: Shape firm wheat-dough baatis and bake until cooked.
Cook lentils with spices to make dal.
Crush baati for churma and mix with ghee and jaggery; serve together.

name: Sarson Ka Saag
steps: Wash and chop greens; simmer until soft.
Blend or mash greens and cook with ginger and garlic.
Stir in a little cornmeal to thicken and finish with butter.

name: Makki Ki Roti
steps: Mix maize flour with warm water and salt.
Pat into flat rotis between damp hands.
Cook on a hot griddle until done and serve with a little ghee.

name: Kadhi Pakora
steps: Whisk yogurt, gram flour and water until smooth.
Simmer with spices, stirring often until thickened.
Fry onion pakoras and add to kadhi shortly before serving.

name: Shahi Paneer
steps: Cook onion, tomatoes and cashews until soft and blend.
Simmer the sauce with spices and a little cream.
Add paneer cubes and heat gently without breaking them.

name: Matar Paneer
steps: Cook onion, tomato and spices into a gravy.
Add peas and simmer until tender.
Add paneer cubes and cook gently for several minutes.

name: Chicken Chettinad
steps: Roast coconut and spices, then grind to a paste.
Sauté onion, curry leaves and tomato.
Add chicken and spice paste with water; simmer until cooked.

name: Kerala Fish Moilee
steps: Sauté onion, ginger, green chilli and curry leaves.
Add thin coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add fish and cook gently; finish with thick coconut milk.

name: Appam and Stew
steps: Cook appams in a hot appam pan until the edges are lacy.
Simmer vegetables with whole spices until tender.
Add coconut milk and heat gently without boiling hard.

name: Kashmiri Dum Aloo
steps: Parboil and prick small potatoes.
Cook yogurt with spices over low heat, stirring continuously.
Add potatoes and water; simmer until the gravy coats them.

name: Vegetable Momos
steps: Knead flour and water into a smooth dough.
Stir-fry finely chopped vegetables with ginger and soy sauce.
Fill thin dough wrappers, pleat and steam until cooked.

name: Chicken Momos
steps: Knead flour and water into a smooth dough.
Mix minced chicken with onion, ginger, garlic and seasoning.
Fill wrappers, seal and steam until the chicken is fully cooked.

name: Egg Dosa
steps: Spread dosa batter on a hot pan.
Crack an egg over the dosa and spread lightly; add onion and seasoning.
Cook until the egg is fully set and the dosa is crisp.

name: Chicken Shawarma Roll
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt, garlic and spices.
Cook chicken thoroughly in a pan and slice.
Wrap in flatbread with vegetables and a yogurt-based sauce.

name: Bhel Puri
steps: Chop vegetables and boil potato.
Mix puffed rice with vegetables and chutneys just before serving.
Top with coriander and crunchy sev if available.

name: Rava Dosa
steps: Mix flours with water, cumin, chilli and salt into a thin batter.
Rest briefly so the rava hydrates.
Pour in a thin lace pattern on a hot pan and cook until crisp.

name: Onion Uttapam
steps: Spread a thick circle of batter on a hot pan.
Top with chopped onion, tomato, chilli and coriander.
Drizzle oil and cook both sides until the centre is done.

name: Chicken Pakora
steps: Cut chicken into small pieces and marinate with lemon and spices.
Coat with gram flour and a little water.
Fry in batches until crisp and chicken is fully cooked.

name: Mutton Biryani
steps: Marinate mutton with yogurt, spices and herbs.
Cook mutton until tender and parboil rice separately.
Layer rice over mutton and cook covered until flavours combine and rice is done.

name: Prawn Fry
steps: Clean prawns and coat with spices, lemon and ginger-garlic paste.
Rest briefly.
Pan-fry until prawns are opaque and cooked; toss with curry leaves.

name: Chicken Lollipop
steps: Prepare chicken wings and marinate with sauces and spices.
Coat lightly with cornflour.
Fry or bake until crisp and ensure chicken is fully cooked.

name: Vegetable Cutlet
steps: Mash cooked vegetables with spices and coriander.
Shape into patties and coat with breadcrumbs.
Shallow-fry until golden on both sides.

name: Kheer
steps: Wash rice and add to simmering milk.
Cook slowly, stirring often, until rice softens and milk thickens.
Add sugar, cardamom and nuts; serve warm or chilled.

name: Badam Halwa
steps: Soak almonds, peel and grind with milk.
Cook the paste with sugar over low heat, stirring constantly.
Add ghee gradually until glossy and thick; flavour with cardamom.

name: Pesarapappu Payasam
steps: Roast moong dal and cook until soft.
Melt jaggery with a little water and strain.
Combine dal, jaggery and coconut milk; heat gently and garnish with cashews.

name: Chakkara Pongal
steps: Cook rice and moong dal until soft.
Melt jaggery with a little water and strain into the rice mixture.
Simmer with cardamom and finish with ghee-fried cashews.

name: Andhra Egg Pulusu
steps: Boil and peel eggs; make small slits.
Prepare onion-tomato masala and add tamarind water.
Add eggs and simmer until the tangy gravy thickens.

name: Kodi Kura
steps: Sauté onion and ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato, spices and chicken; mix well.
Add ground coconut if desired and simmer until chicken is cooked.

name: Ulli Karam Dosa
steps: Grind onion, red chillies, garlic and cumin into a coarse paste.
Spread dosa batter on a hot pan.
Apply a thin layer of ulli karam and cook until crisp.

name: Chintapandu Pulihora
steps: Extract tamarind pulp and cook it with turmeric and salt until thick.
Temper mustard seeds, peanuts, chillies and curry leaves.
Mix the tamarind mixture into cooled rice.

name: Bendakaya Fry
steps: Wash and dry okra fully before slicing.
Sauté with cumin, turmeric and salt until moisture evaporates.
Add chilli powder and fry until tender and lightly crisp.

name: Cabbage Poriyal
steps: Finely shred cabbage.
Temper mustard seeds, urad dal, chilli and curry leaves.
Add cabbage and salt, cook until tender, then mix in coconut.

name: Vegetable Khichdi
steps: Rinse rice and moong dal.
Sauté cumin and vegetables, then add rice, dal, turmeric and water.
Pressure-cook until soft and creamy; adjust seasoning.

name: Pani Puri
steps: Mash boiled potato and chickpeas with seasoning.
Blend mint, coriander and spices with water for pani.
Fill puris with potato mixture and add pani just before eating.

name: Rasmalai
steps: Make chenna from curdled milk and shape into discs.
Cook discs in light sugar syrup until expanded.
Simmer milk with sugar, cardamom and saffron; chill discs in the flavoured milk.

name: Chicken Pepper Fry
steps: Sauté onion, curry leaves and ginger-garlic paste.
Add chicken, pepper, fennel and salt; cook covered until done.
Uncover and fry until the masala coats the chicken.

name: Mutton Sukka
steps: Cook mutton with turmeric and water until tender.
Roast coconut and spices and grind coarsely.
Sauté onion and curry leaves, add mutton and spice mix, and fry until dry.

name: Paneer Bhurji
steps: Crumble paneer.
Sauté onion, chilli and tomato with spices.
Add paneer and cook briefly until well combined.

name: Corn Chaat
steps: Boil or steam sweet corn until tender.
Mix with chopped onion, tomato, lemon and chaat masala.
Garnish with coriander and serve immediately.

name: Fruit Custard
steps: Mix custard powder with a little cold milk.
Heat remaining milk with sugar and stir in the custard mixture until thick.
Cool completely, fold in chopped fruit and chill before serving.

name: Carrot Halwa
steps: Grate carrots and cook in milk until softened.
Add sugar and simmer until the mixture thickens.
Stir in ghee, cardamom and fried cashews.

name: Vegetable Sandwich
steps: Spread butter or chutney on bread slices.
Layer sliced vegetables and season lightly.
Close, slice and serve; toast if preferred.

name: Chicken Sandwich
steps: Shred fully cooked chicken and season with pepper.
Mix with a little mayonnaise if desired.
Layer with lettuce and cucumber between bread slices.

name: Garlic Naan
steps: Make and rest a soft naan dough until risen.
Roll into flat ovals and sprinkle with chopped garlic.
Cook on a hot surface and brush with garlic butter and coriander.

name: Jeera Rice
steps: Rinse and soak basmati rice briefly.
Heat ghee and toast cumin and bay leaf.
Add rice, water and salt; cover and cook until fluffy.

name: Dal Tadka
steps: Cook dal with turmeric until soft.
Prepare onion-tomato masala and stir into dal.
Heat ghee or oil and bloom cumin, garlic and dried chilli; pour over dal.

name: Chicken Do Pyaza
steps: Sauté sliced onions until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste, tomato, spices and chicken.
Add yogurt and extra onion pieces; simmer until chicken is cooked.

name: Andhra Mutton Curry
steps: Sauté onion and ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato, spices and mutton; stir well.
Add water and pressure-cook or simmer until mutton is tender.

name: Andhra Fish Fry
steps: Pat fish dry and coat with spices, lemon and ginger-garlic paste.
Rest to marinate briefly.
Shallow-fry until crisp and cooked through.

name: Coconut Rice
steps: Cool cooked rice.
Temper mustard seeds, urad dal, cashews and curry leaves.
Add grated coconut and rice; toss gently with salt.

name: Methi Malai Paneer
steps: Sauté onion, ginger and cashews; blend into a paste.
Cook fenugreek leaves until wilted and add the paste.
Add paneer and cream, then simmer gently.

name: Egg Bhurji
steps: Sauté onion, chilli and tomato with spices.
Beat eggs with salt and pour into the pan.
Stir gently until eggs are fully set; garnish with coriander.

name: Chicken Roast
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt, lemon and spices.
Roast in an oven or cook covered in a pan until nearly done.
Uncover and roast or fry until browned and fully cooked.

name: Vegetable Paniyaram
steps: Sauté chopped vegetables with mustard seeds and curry leaves.
Mix vegetables into idli batter.
Pour into a paniyaram pan and cook each side until golden.

name: Chana Masala
steps: Soak and cook chickpeas until tender.
Sauté cumin, onion, ginger-garlic paste and tomato.
Add chana masala and chickpeas; simmer until gravy thickens.

name: Aloo Gobi Paratha
steps: Make a soft wheat-flour dough.
Cook and mash potato and cauliflower with spices.
Fill, roll carefully and cook on a hot pan with a little ghee.

name: Mango Lassi
steps: Peel and chop ripe mango.
Blend mango with yogurt, milk and sugar.
Add cardamom if desired and serve chilled.

name: Masala Chai
steps: Boil water with crushed ginger and cardamom.
Add tea leaves and simmer briefly.
Add milk and sugar, simmer, then strain into cups.

name: Filter Coffee
steps: Brew ground coffee using a filter or strong infusion.
Heat milk and sweeten to taste.
Combine coffee decoction and milk; serve hot.

name: Buttermilk
steps: Whisk yogurt with chilled water until smooth.
Add crushed cumin, ginger, salt and chopped coriander.
Mix well and serve chilled.

name: Andhra Karam Podi
steps: Dry-roast dals and sesame separately until fragrant.
Roast chillies and cool all ingredients.
Grind with garlic and salt into a coarse powder.

name: Kandi Podi
steps: Dry-roast toor dal until aromatic.
Roast chillies and cumin, then cool.
Grind everything with garlic and salt into a powder.

name: Dondakaya Fry
steps: Wash and slice ivy gourd.
Temper mustard seeds and sauté onion.
Add ivy gourd, turmeric and salt; cover-cook, then fry with chilli powder.

name: Beerakaya Pappu
steps: Peel and chop ridge gourd.
Cook dal with ridge gourd, chilli and turmeric until soft.
Mash lightly and add a garlic and mustard-seed tempering.

name: Gobi Paratha
steps: Make a soft dough and grate cauliflower.
Mix cauliflower with ginger, chilli, cumin and coriander.
Fill and roll dough, then cook on a hot pan with a little ghee.

name: Mutton Keema Paratha
steps: Cook minced mutton with onion, ginger-garlic and spices until dry.
Make and rest wheat dough.
Fill dough with cooled keema, roll gently and cook thoroughly on a hot pan.

name: Prawn Biryani
steps: Marinate prawns briefly with yogurt and spices.
Parboil rice and prepare fried onions with herbs.
Layer prawns and rice and cook covered just until prawns are done and rice is fluffy.

name: Mango Pickle
steps: Wash and dry raw mango completely, then cut into pieces.
Mix with salt, mustard, chilli and fenugreek powders.
Add oil, mix thoroughly and store in a clean dry jar.

name: Green Peas Masala
steps: Sauté cumin, onion and ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato and spices; cook until soft.
Add peas and water, simmer until tender and the gravy thickens.

name: Veg Hakka Noodles
steps: Boil noodles until just tender and drain.
Stir-fry sliced vegetables on high heat.
Add noodles and soy sauce, toss well and garnish with spring onion.

name: Egg Noodles
steps: Boil noodles and drain well.
Scramble eggs in a hot pan, then stir-fry vegetables.
Add noodles and soy sauce; toss until hot and garnish.

name: Chicken Curry Andhra Style
steps: Sauté onion, curry leaves and ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato, chilli powder and other spices, then chicken.
Add water and simmer until chicken is completely cooked.

name: Bajra Roti
steps: Mix bajra flour, salt and warm water into a soft dough.
Pat into flat rounds with damp hands.
Cook on a hot griddle until done and serve warm.

name: Vegetable Handi
steps: Cook mixed vegetables until nearly tender.
Make a gravy with onion, tomato, cashew paste and spices.
Add vegetables and yogurt, then simmer until creamy and cooked.

name: Chicken Tandoori
steps: Make shallow cuts in chicken and coat with yogurt, lemon and spices.
Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
Bake or grill until browned and the chicken is fully cooked.

name: Schezwan Fried Rice
steps: Stir-fry chopped vegetables on high heat.
Add cooled rice and Schezwan sauce.
Toss until evenly coated and steaming hot; garnish with spring onion.

name: Pesarattu Upma
steps: Soak and grind green gram with ginger and chilli for pesarattu batter.
Prepare a simple vegetable upma with rava.
Cook pesarattu on a hot pan, add upma filling and fold.

name: Andhra Tomato Pickle
steps: Cook chopped tomatoes until thick and moisture reduces.
Roast and grind mustard and fenugreek; mix with chilli powder and salt.
Add spice mix and garlic tempering, cool and store refrigerated in a clean jar.

name: Mutton Pepper Curry
steps: Cook mutton with turmeric and water until tender.
Sauté onion, curry leaves and ginger-garlic paste.
Add mutton, crushed pepper and fennel; simmer until the gravy thickens.

name: Vegetable Oats Upma
steps: Dry-roast oats briefly.
Sauté mustard seeds, curry leaves, onion and vegetables.
Add water and oats, stir and cook until soft but not mushy.

name: Paneer Pulao
steps: Rinse and soak rice briefly.
Sauté whole spices, onion, peas and paneer gently.
Add rice, water and mint; cover and cook until rice is fluffy.

name: Andhra Chicken Biryani
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt, herbs and spices.
Parboil rice and fry onions.
Layer rice over chicken and cook covered on low heat until both are fully cooked.

name: Vegetable Pesarattu
steps: Soak and grind green gram with ginger, chilli and cumin.
Mix in finely chopped onion and carrot if desired.
Spread on a hot pan and cook both sides until crisp.

name: Sweet Pongal
steps: Cook rice and moong dal until very soft.
Melt jaggery with a little water and strain into the cooked mixture.
Simmer with cardamom and ghee-fried cashews until creamy.

name: Chicken Sukka
steps: Sauté onion and curry leaves with spices.
Add chicken and cook covered until fully cooked.
Add roasted coconut and spice mixture and fry until the masala clings to the chicken.

name: Cucumber Raita
steps: Whisk yogurt until smooth.
Grate or finely chop cucumber and squeeze out excess water.
Mix with yogurt, cumin, salt and coriander; chill before serving.

name: Boondi Raita
steps: Whisk yogurt with a little water until creamy.
Add boondi and season with cumin, chilli and salt.
Garnish with coriander and serve soon so boondi retains some texture.

name: Andhra Sajja Roti
steps: Mix flour and salt with warm water into a soft dough.
Pat into flat rotis using damp hands.
Cook on a hot griddle until both sides are done.

name: Chilli Paneer
steps: Coat paneer lightly with cornflour and pan-fry until golden.
Stir-fry garlic, onion and capsicum.
Add soy sauce and a little water slurry, then toss paneer through the sauce.

name: Chicken Kathi Roll
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt and spices, then cook thoroughly.
Cook flatbreads and prepare sliced onion.
Wrap chicken and onion in the flatbread with chutney or sauce.

name: Vegetable Pulao Andhra Style
steps: Rinse and soak rice briefly.
Sauté whole spices, onion, ginger-garlic paste and vegetables.
Add rice, mint, water and salt; cover and cook until fluffy.

name: Chicken Livers Fry
steps: Clean liver carefully and cut into even pieces.
Sauté onion, curry leaves and ginger-garlic paste with spices.
Add liver and cook thoroughly, stirring until no raw centre remains.

name: Kaju Curry
steps: Lightly toast cashews and set aside.
Cook onion, tomato and spices, then blend into a smooth gravy.
Simmer gravy with cashews and finish with a little cream.

name: Chana Sundal
steps: Soak and cook chickpeas until tender.
Temper mustard seeds, urad dal, chilli and curry leaves.
Add chickpeas, salt and grated coconut; toss and serve.

name: Kothimeera Pachadi
steps: Wash coriander leaves and dry them well.
Grind with green chillies, tamarind, garlic, cumin and salt.
Adjust texture with a little water and serve fresh.

name: Andhra Gongura Chicken
steps: Cook gongura leaves until softened and set aside.
Sauté onion and ginger-garlic paste, then add chicken and spices.
Cook chicken thoroughly, add gongura and simmer until the gravy comes together.

name: Vegetable Kurma South Indian
steps: Cook vegetables until nearly tender.
Blend coconut, cashews, fennel and ginger into a paste.
Sauté onion, add paste and vegetables, then simmer until cooked.

name: Mutton Boti Curry
steps: Clean the meat pieces thoroughly.
Cook with onion, tomato, ginger-garlic and spices until tender.
Simmer until the gravy thickens and serve hot.

name: Crispy Corn
steps: Cook corn and drain thoroughly; pat dry carefully.
Toss with cornflour, rice flour and seasoning.
Fry in small batches until crisp; season with pepper and lemon.

name: Besan Chilla
steps: Whisk gram flour with water and spices into a smooth batter.
Mix in chopped onion, tomato and coriander.
Spread on a hot pan and cook both sides until golden.

name: Chicken Tikka
steps: Cut chicken into even pieces and marinate with yogurt and spices.
Thread chicken and capsicum onto skewers.
Grill or pan-cook until lightly charred and chicken is fully cooked.

name: Vegetable Momos Soup
steps: Prepare or steam vegetable momos until cooked.
Simmer stock with ginger, garlic and chopped vegetables.
Add momos to the hot broth and garnish with spring onion.

name: Andhra Gongura Prawn Curry
steps: Cook gongura leaves until soft and set aside.
Sauté onion, garlic and spices; add prawns.
Cook prawns until opaque, add gongura and simmer briefly.

name: Rava Laddu
steps: Roast rava in ghee until fragrant and cool slightly.
Mix with powdered sugar, cardamom and fried cashews.
Add small amounts of warm milk as needed and shape into laddus.

name: Vegetable Biryani Andhra
steps: Marinate vegetables with yogurt, herbs and spices.
Parboil rice separately.
Layer vegetables and rice, cover tightly and cook until rice and vegetables are done.

name: Andhra Chicken Pulusu
steps: Sauté onion and ginger-garlic paste, then add tomato and spices.
Add chicken and stir until coated.
Add tamarind water and simmer until chicken is fully cooked and gravy thickens.

name: Daddojanam
steps: Mash cooled rice gently and mix with yogurt and milk.
Prepare a tempering with mustard seeds, ginger and curry leaves.
Mix into rice, season with salt and serve cool.

name: Andhra Kobbari Annam
steps: Cool cooked rice.
Temper mustard seeds, green chilli, cashews and curry leaves.
Add coconut and rice with salt; mix gently until heated through.

name: Chicken Keema Balls Curry
steps: Season minced chicken and shape into small balls.
Prepare onion-tomato gravy with spices.
Add balls gently and simmer until fully cooked through.

name: Vegetable Manchow Soup
steps: Stir-fry garlic and finely chopped vegetables.
Add water or stock and simmer until vegetables are tender.
Thicken lightly with cornflour slurry and season with soy sauce.

name: Egg Puffs
steps: Boil eggs and cut in half.
Cook onion with curry leaves and spices.
Wrap egg and masala in pastry and bake according to pastry instructions until golden.

name: Mysore Masala Dosa
steps: Blend red chillies and garlic into a spicy chutney.
Prepare potato masala with onion and mustard seeds.
Cook dosa, spread chutney, add potato masala and fold.

name: Andhra Gongura Mutton Curry
steps: Cook mutton until tender.
Sauté onion and ginger-garlic paste with spices.
Add softened gongura and cooked mutton; simmer until flavours blend.

name: Ridge Gourd Chutney
steps: Peel and chop ridge gourd and cook until soft.
Sauté chillies and garlic, then cool.
Grind with ridge gourd, tamarind, cumin and salt.

name: Chicken Dum Biryani
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt, spices and herbs.
Parboil rice and layer over the marinated chicken.
Seal the pot and cook on low heat until chicken and rice are fully cooked.

name: Paneer Tikka Masala
steps: Marinate paneer and capsicum in spiced yogurt and pan-grill.
Prepare a tomato-onion gravy and blend smooth.
Add grilled paneer and simmer with a little cream.

name: Kaju Pulao
steps: Rinse and soak rice briefly.
Toast cashews and whole spices in ghee, then sauté onion.
Add rice, water, mint and salt; cook covered until fluffy.

name: Andhra Spicy Potato Fry
steps: Boil potatoes until just tender and cut into cubes.
Temper cumin, garlic and curry leaves in oil.
Add potatoes, turmeric and chilli powder; fry until crisp-edged.

name: Mushroom Biryani
steps: Clean and slice mushrooms.
Sauté onion, mushrooms, yogurt, herbs and biryani spices.
Add partly cooked rice and water as needed; cover and cook until done.

name: Chicken Lollipop Dry
steps: Marinate prepared chicken wings with sauces and seasoning.
Coat lightly with cornflour.
Fry or bake until crisp and ensure the chicken is fully cooked.

name: Ghee Roast Dosa
steps: Prepare a smooth spicy red chutney from chillies and garlic.
Spread dosa batter thinly on a hot pan.
Brush with ghee, add chutney if desired and cook until crisp.

name: Andhra Pulasa Pulusu
steps: Extract tamarind pulp and prepare the spice base.
Cook onion with spices and tamarind water until the raw smell fades.
Add fish and simmer gently until cooked; avoid stirring roughly.

name: Vegetable Jalfrezi
steps: Cut vegetables into strips.
Stir-fry onion and vegetables until just tender.
Add tomato and spices and cook until the vegetables are coated.

name: Andhra Minapa Sunnundalu
steps: Dry-roast urad dal until fragrant and cool completely.
Grind into a fine powder and mix with powdered jaggery and cardamom.
Add warm ghee gradually and shape into small balls.

name: Andhra Ragi Dosa
steps: Mix flours with yogurt, water, cumin and chopped chilli.
Rest the batter briefly.
Pour thinly onto a hot pan and cook both sides until crisp.

name: Vegetable Kurma with Chapati
steps: Cook vegetables until nearly tender.
Blend coconut and cashews into a smooth paste.
Cook onion and spices, add paste and vegetables, simmer and serve with chapati.

name: Andhra Chicken Liver Curry
steps: Clean liver carefully and prepare onion-tomato masala.
Add liver and spices with a little water.
Cook thoroughly until liver is fully cooked and gravy thickens.

name: Masala Omelette
steps: Beat eggs with chopped onion, chilli, tomato and seasoning.
Heat a lightly oiled pan and pour in the mixture.
Cook until set, flip carefully and cook the other side.

name: Andhra Muddapappu
steps: Rinse toor dal and cook with water and a pinch of turmeric until soft.
Mash to a smooth, thick consistency.
Season with salt and a little ghee; serve with rice.

name: Cabbage Pakoda
steps: Shred cabbage and mix with spices and flours.
Add only enough water to bind the mixture.
Drop small portions into hot oil and fry until crisp.

name: Paneer Lababdar
steps: Cook tomatoes, onion and cashews and blend into a smooth sauce.
Simmer with spices and a little butter.
Add paneer and cream and cook gently until heated through.

name: Chicken Tawa Fry
steps: Marinate chicken with lemon, ginger-garlic paste and spices.
Cook covered on a hot pan until nearly done.
Add onion and tomato and fry until chicken is fully cooked and masala is thick.

name: Andhra Vegetable Pulao
steps: Rinse rice and chop vegetables.
Sauté whole spices, vegetables and mint.
Add rice, water and salt; cover and cook until the grains are fluffy.

name: Mango Shrikhand
steps: Strain yogurt until thick.
Whisk with mango pulp, sugar and cardamom.
Chill and garnish with saffron if desired.

name: Chicken Clear Soup
steps: Simmer chicken with ginger, garlic and water until cooked.
Add carrot and simmer until tender.
Strain if desired, season with pepper and salt, and serve hot.

name: Andhra Bendakaya Pulusu
steps: Extract tamarind pulp and sauté okra separately.
Cook onion and spices, then add tamarind water.
Add okra and a little jaggery; simmer until the gravy thickens.

name: Puri Bhaji
steps: Make dough, roll small puris and fry until puffed.
Cook potatoes with onion, mustard seeds and turmeric.
Serve hot puris with potato bhaji.

name: Vegetable Hakka Noodles Spicy
steps: Boil noodles and drain.
Stir-fry vegetables on high heat.
Add noodles, chilli sauce and soy sauce; toss and serve hot.

name: Andhra Kakarakaya Fry
steps: Slice bitter gourd and remove seeds if desired.
Sauté until moisture reduces and add spices and salt.
Cook until tender and lightly crisp; add a little jaggery to balance bitterness.

name: Methi Thepla
steps: Mix flour, chopped fenugreek, yogurt and spices into dough.
Rest briefly and roll into thin discs.
Cook on a hot pan with a little oil until cooked.

name: Vegetable Appe
steps: Mix chopped vegetables into idli batter.
Grease an appe pan and fill each cavity.
Cook covered, turn each appe and cook until golden and cooked through.

name: Andhra Chicken Kaju Curry
steps: Soak or lightly toast cashews and blend with water.
Sauté onion, ginger-garlic paste and tomato with spices.
Add chicken and cashew paste with water; simmer until fully cooked.

name: Andhra Gongura Pachadi Spicy
steps: Wash and dry gongura leaves thoroughly.
Sauté leaves and chillies until soft, then cool and grind with salt.
Temper mustard, fenugreek and garlic and mix into the chutney.

name: Vegetable Cutlet Sandwich
steps: Prepare spiced vegetable patties and coat with breadcrumbs.
Shallow-fry patties until crisp.
Place in bread with chutney and sliced vegetables, then serve.

name: Chicken Korma Hyderabadi
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt and spices.
Blend fried onions and cashews into a paste.
Cook chicken with the paste and a little water until tender and fully cooked.

name: Andhra Pappu Charu
steps: Cook and mash toor dal.
Boil tamarind water with tomato, chilli and spices.
Add dal, simmer and finish with curry-leaf tempering.

name: Vegetable Pulao with Raita
steps: Cook rice with vegetables, whole spices and mint until fluffy.
Whisk yogurt with grated cucumber and seasoning for raita.
Serve pulao with chilled raita.

name: Andhra Chicken Fry Boneless
steps: Cut chicken into even pieces and marinate with lemon and spices.
Pan-cook until fully cooked.
Add curry leaves and fry until the outside is lightly crisp.

name: Saggubiyyam Payasam
steps: Rinse and soak sago briefly if needed.
Cook sago in water until translucent, then add milk.
Sweeten and garnish with cardamom and ghee-fried nuts.

name: Vegetable Stuffed Paratha
steps: Make soft dough and prepare a cooked mixed-vegetable filling.
Fill dough balls and roll gently.
Cook on a hot pan with a little ghee until golden on both sides.

name: Andhra Chilli Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken with ginger-garlic paste and spices.
Cook chicken fully in a pan with a little water.
Add sliced green chillies, onion and curry leaves; fry until aromatic.

name: Lemon Sevai
steps: Cook rice vermicelli according to package directions and drain.
Temper mustard seeds, peanuts, chillies and curry leaves.
Turn off heat, add lemon juice and toss with vermicelli.

name: Andhra Chicken Pakodi
steps: Cut chicken into small pieces and marinate with spices.
Coat with gram flour and rice flour with a little water.
Fry in small batches until crisp and chicken is fully cooked.

name: Vegetable Cheese Sandwich
steps: Layer sliced vegetables and cheese on bread.
Butter the outside lightly.
Toast in a pan or sandwich maker until the bread is golden and cheese melts.

name: Andhra Mutton Fry
steps: Cook mutton with turmeric and water until tender.
Sauté onion, curry leaves and ginger-garlic paste with spices.
Add mutton and fry until the masala is dry and well coated.

name: Vegetable Dal Soup
steps: Cook moong dal with chopped vegetables until soft.
Mash or blend to the preferred texture.
Season with cumin, pepper and salt; simmer briefly.

name: Andhra Allam Pachadi
steps: Peel and chop ginger.
Grind ginger with tamarind, chillies, jaggery and salt.
Temper mustard seeds in oil and mix into the chutney.

name: Vegetable Sagu
steps: Cook mixed vegetables until nearly tender.
Grind coconut, green chillies, coriander and fennel into a paste.
Sauté onion, add paste and vegetables, then simmer until done.

name: Andhra Chicken Pepper Curry
steps: Sauté onion, curry leaves and ginger-garlic paste.
Add chicken, tomato, pepper and seasoning.
Simmer until chicken is completely cooked and the gravy thickens.

name: Vegetable Pani Puri
steps: Cook potatoes and chickpeas and season them.
Blend mint, coriander, tamarind and spices with water for pani.
Fill puris with potato mixture and add pani just before serving.

name: Andhra Chicken Curry Coconut
steps: Blend coconut with a little water into a smooth paste.
Sauté onion, ginger-garlic paste, tomato and spices.
Add chicken and coconut paste with water; simmer until chicken is cooked.

name: Vegetable Pesarattu Roll
steps: Soak and grind green gram with ginger and chilli.
Cook a thin pesarattu on a hot pan.
Fill with sautéed vegetables and roll up to serve.

name: Andhra Mutton Pulusu
steps: Cook mutton until tender.
Prepare onion-tomato masala and add tamarind water and spices.
Add cooked mutton and simmer until the gravy thickens.

name: Coconut Ladoo
steps: Warm a little ghee in a pan.
Add coconut and condensed milk and stir over low heat until the mixture holds together.
Cool slightly, add cardamom and shape into small balls.

name: Vegetable Pulao Quick
steps: Rinse rice and drain.
Sauté whole spices, onion, ginger-garlic paste and vegetables.
Add rice, water and salt; cover and cook until tender.

name: Andhra Egg Fried Rice
steps: Scramble eggs in a hot pan until fully set.
Sauté onion, chilli and curry leaves.
Add cooled rice, pepper and salt, then toss with the eggs until hot.

name: Vegetable Manchurian Gravy
steps: Shape finely chopped vegetables mixed with flour into balls and cook until golden.
Sauté garlic and make a sauce with soy sauce and water.
Thicken with cornflour slurry, add vegetable balls and simmer briefly.

name: Andhra Chicken Curry Simple
steps: Sauté onion until soft and add ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato and spices, then chicken.
Add water and simmer until chicken is fully cooked.

name: Sweet Corn Soup
steps: Cook sweet corn and chopped vegetables in water or stock.
Blend a portion of corn for a thicker texture.
Return to the pot, thicken lightly with cornflour slurry and season.

name: Andhra Minapa Garelu
steps: Soak urad dal and grind to a thick fluffy batter.
Mix in chilli, ginger, cumin and curry leaves.
Shape into vadas and fry until golden and cooked through.

name: Andhra Chicken Majjiga Pulusu
steps: Cook chicken with onion, ginger-garlic paste and spices until tender.
Whisk yogurt with a little water until smooth.
Lower heat, stir in yogurt and simmer gently without boiling hard until fully cooked.

name: Vegetable Dal Tadka
steps: Cook dal and vegetables with turmeric until soft.
Mash lightly and simmer with tomato and salt.
Temper cumin and garlic in oil or ghee and stir into the dal.

name: Andhra Pesara Punugulu
steps: Prepare a thick ground green-gram batter.
Mix in chopped onion, chilli, ginger and cumin.
Drop small portions into hot oil and fry until golden and cooked through.

name: Vegetable Raita
steps: Whisk yogurt until smooth.
Finely chop or grate cucumber, carrot and onion.
Mix vegetables into yogurt with cumin and salt; chill before serving.

name: Andhra Chicken Roast Spicy
steps: Marinate chicken with spices and ginger-garlic paste.
Cook covered until chicken is fully cooked.
Add onion and curry leaves and fry until the masala is dry and spicy.

name: Vegetable Biryani Quick
steps: Sauté onion, vegetables and biryani masala.
Add rinsed rice, yogurt, mint and measured water.
Cover and cook on low heat until rice and vegetables are tender.

name: Andhra Prawn Iguru
steps: Sauté onion and ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato and spices and cook into a thick masala.
Add prawns and cook until opaque and the gravy clings to them.

name: Vegetable Semiya Upma
steps: Roast vermicelli until lightly golden.
Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves, onion and vegetables.
Add water and salt, then vermicelli; cook until water is absorbed.

name: Andhra Chicken Biryani Easy
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt and biryani spices.
Sauté onions and herbs, add chicken and cook until partly done.
Add rinsed rice and measured water, cover and cook until chicken and rice are done.

name: Vegetable Ragi Mudde
steps: Bring salted water to a boil.
Mix ragi flour with a little water and stir into the pot.
Cook while stirring until thick and smooth; shape into balls while warm.

name: Andhra Chicken Drumstick Curry
steps: Sauté onion and ginger-garlic paste until fragrant.
Add tomato and spices, then drumsticks.
Add water, cover and simmer until chicken is fully cooked near the bone.

name: Vegetable Dosa
steps: Spread dosa batter on a hot pan.
Top with finely chopped vegetables and press gently.
Drizzle oil and cook until crisp; flip briefly if needed.

name: Andhra Gongura Rice
steps: Cook gongura leaves with chillies until soft and grind coarsely.
Temper mustard seeds, peanuts and garlic.
Mix gongura paste and tempering with cooled rice and salt.

name: Andhra Chicken 65
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt and spices.
Coat with cornflour and cook in batches until crisp and fully cooked.
Toss with curry leaves and green chillies sautéed in a little oil.

name: Vegetable Sambar Idli
steps: Steam idlis until fluffy.
Cook dal and vegetables with tamarind and sambar powder.
Pour hot sambar over idlis and garnish with curry leaves.

name: Andhra Chicken Curry with Potatoes
steps: Sauté onion and ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato, spices, chicken and potato pieces.
Add water and simmer until potatoes are tender and chicken is fully cooked.

name: Vegetable Coconut Rice
steps: Cook and cool rice.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves, then sauté carrot and peas until tender.
Add coconut, rice and salt; toss gently until heated through.

name: Andhra Spicy Egg Curry
steps: Boil and peel eggs; make shallow slits.
Cook onion, tomato, chillies and spices into a thick gravy.
Add eggs and simmer for several minutes until flavours combine.

name: Vegetable Cheese Dosa
steps: Spread dosa batter thinly on a hot pan.
Add chopped vegetables and grated cheese.
Cook until crisp and cheese melts; fold and serve.

name: Andhra Chicken Curry Pepper
steps: Sauté onion, curry leaves and ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato, chicken, crushed pepper and seasoning.
Simmer until chicken is completely cooked and gravy is thick.

name: Vegetable Poha
steps: Rinse poha briefly and drain.
Sauté mustard seeds, onion, carrot and peas until tender.
Add poha, salt and turmeric; warm through and finish with lemon.

name: Andhra Chicken Curry Tomato
steps: Sauté onion and ginger-garlic paste.
Add plenty of chopped tomato and spices; cook until soft.
Add chicken and water, then simmer until fully cooked.

name: Vegetable Pulao Mint
steps: Rinse and soak rice briefly.
Sauté whole spices, onion, vegetables and mint.
Add rice, water and salt; cover and cook until fluffy.

name: Andhra Chicken Curry Green Chilli
steps: Sauté onion and ginger-garlic paste.
Add green chillies, tomato and spices, then chicken.
Add water and simmer until chicken is fully cooked.

name: Vegetable Masala Khichdi
steps: Rinse rice and dal.
Sauté vegetables and spices, then add rice, dal and water.
Pressure-cook until soft and creamy; adjust salt.

name: Andhra Chicken Curry Home Style
steps: Sauté onion, curry leaves and ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato, chilli powder and chicken; stir to coat.
Add water and simmer until the chicken is fully cooked and gravy thickens.

name: Vegetable Korma Rice
steps: Cook rice with whole spices until fluffy.
Prepare vegetable korma with coconut-cashew paste.
Serve the rice with the vegetable korma.

name: Andhra Chicken Fry Curry Leaves
steps: Marinate chicken with lemon, ginger-garlic paste and spices.
Cook chicken until fully done.
Add plenty of curry leaves and fry until fragrant and lightly crisp.

name: Vegetable Pulao Cashew
steps: Rinse rice and chop vegetables.
Toast cashews and whole spices in ghee, then sauté onion and vegetables.
Add rice, water and salt; cover and cook until fluffy.

name: Andhra Chicken Curry Traditional
steps: Sauté onion and ginger-garlic paste until fragrant.
Add tomato and spices, then chicken.
Add water and simmer until chicken is thoroughly cooked.

name: Vegetable Rava Idli
steps: Roast rava and cool.
Mix with yogurt, grated carrot and a little water; rest briefly.
Fold in fruit salt and steam in greased moulds until set.

name: Andhra Chicken Curry Spicy Home
steps: Sauté onion and ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato, chilli powder, pepper and chicken.
Add water and cook covered until the chicken is fully cooked.

name: Vegetable Biryani Mint
steps: Marinate vegetables with yogurt, mint and spices.
Parboil rice and fry onions.
Layer rice and vegetables, cover tightly and cook until done.
